extraction.document_summary: FWD Future First is a term life insurance plan designed to pay a lump sum if the person insured dies or is diagnosed with terminal illness, and it also includes an “Exclusive Recovery Programme” for eligible recovery-related expenses and support services. Under the base plan, on death the full sum insured is paid to beneficiaries, and FWD may pay S$5,000 in advance for funeral expenses upon request. If the person insured is diagnosed with terminal illness, the full sum insured is paid to you/beneficiaries. The base plan also includes up to 10 counselling/life coaching sessions (capped at S$5,000 total) and up to 3 legal advice sessions (capped at S$5,000 total). A spouse premium-free 2-year policy with a S$250,000 death sum insured is provided, subject to eligibility (spouse < 60).
quality_notes: The document contains multiple rider product sections, but it is not fully structured as tables; some headings and footnote references are hard to reconcile precisely.
Rider coverage lists (e.g., condition counts) are provided, but detailed definitions/covered lists are explicitly deferred to the Policy Contract.

aliases: FWD Future First Term Life insurance
policies.quick_summary: Term life insurance with base payouts for death/terminal illness plus value-added recovery support (Exclusive Recovery Programme) and a spouse premium-free 2-year term life cover (subject to surviving spouse age). Riders are available for critical illness and other enhancements, with multiple payout mechanics and waiting/survival/claim-limit rules described in the brochure’s rider sections and notes/footnotes (details subject to Policy Contract). Ref: brochure states death/terminal illness pays full sum insured and allows a S$5,000 funeral advance upon request; counselling/legal sessions are capped at S$5,000 each category total.
policies.eligibility_notes: Surviving spouse premium-free 2-year term life cover is for a spouse who is less than 60 years old.
policies.coverage_term_description: Brochure illustration references a 35-year term life purchase for financial protection, but the general term length/options are not stated as a product specification.
important_caveats: The brochure states there are certain conditions such as pre-existing conditions and exclusions where no benefits will be payable (full list in Policy Contract).

Recovery Programme services/eligibility and rider-specific limits/waiting/survival periods are subject to maximum cumulative claim limits and benefit-specific conditions and defined thresholds (Policy Contract).

riders.name: FWD MultiCover CI Rider
riders.description: Multiple critical illness payouts with continued protection across stages and recurrence, including ICU-related benefits and special/juvenile benefits with stated caps and claim-limit rules.
riders.notes: The brochure states up to 900% of sum insured across multiple claims; also includes ICU Benefit (20% capped at S$25,000) for 4+ days, and Severe Intensive Care Unit Benefit (20% for 5+ days with invasive life support).

evidence.quote:
Receive up to 900% of your Sum Insured across multiple claims for early-, intermediate-, late-stage and
recurrent critical illnesses, with protection that continues beyond your first claim4.

riders.name: FWD Total CI Rider
riders.description: Critical illness rider covering 141 early-, intermediate- and late-stage critical illnesses including future unknown illnesses, with 100% ICU invasive life support payout for 5+ days and continued late-stage coverage after an early critical illness claim if 12 months have passed (up to 200% of rider sum insured). Includes protection for 10 special conditions, home care support via base professional services benefit, and medical second opinion reimbursement up to S$1,000; includes future premiums/payment mechanics after early vs claim (as described).
riders.notes: The brochure states: 'Continue to be covered against late-stage critical illnesses even after you have made a claim for early critical illness once 12 months have passed' and describes the Reset Period concept in notes (for Future Protect benefit) for base benefit reduction to zero for 12 months during Reset Period.

evidence.quote:

made a claim for early critical illness once 12 months14 have passed. You can get up to
200% of this rider’s sum insured.

riders.name: FWD Early CI Rider
riders.description: Accelerated payout of base plan in the event of covered early/intermediate/late-stage critical illness (as described), with stated maximum amount payable per lifetime for early- or intermediate-stage critical illness of S$350,000. Includes additional juvenile benefit (20% of original rider sum insured, capped at S$25,000 per condition per life insured) and additional special condition benefit (20% of original rider sum insured, capped at S$25,000 per condition per person insured).
riders.eligibility: Juvenile benefit applies if the person insured is below age 18.
riders.notes: The brochure mentions scenario logic: 'For sum insured of S$350,000 and below, 100% of the sum insured will be paid in a lump sum if the person insured is diagnosed with any covered early-, intermediate- or late-stage critical illness. The rider terminates thereafter.'

riders.name: FWD CI Rider
riders.description: Covers late-stage critical illnesses with an accelerated payout of the base plan. Also includes home care support using the base plan’s professional services benefit of S$5,000 and describes second medical opinion support from an expert of choice (with reimbursement up to S$1,000) if diagnosed with covered critical illness conditions under this rider.
riders.notes: The brochure explicitly states: second medical opinion is available with the FWD CI Rider and reimbursed up to S$1,000.

evidence.quote:
FWD CI Rider

Covering late-stage critical illnesses
Provides an accelerated payout of your base plan in the unfortunate event of a
late-stage critical illness.

With the FWD CI Rider, if you are diagnosed with or suffer from one of the
covered critical illness conditions under this rider, you can seek a second medical
opinion from an expert of your choice.... You’ll be reimbursed for the actual cost, up to
S$1,000.

riders.name: FWD TPD Rider
riders.description: Provides an accelerated payout of the base plan in the event of total and permanent disability (TPD). Includes home care support using the base plan’s professional services benefit of S$5,000 (home nursing services and home modifications).
riders.notes: The brochure states home care support is utilised from the base policy professional services benefit of S$5,000, and describes the forms of reimbursement.

evidence.quote:
FWD TPD Rider

Covering total and permanent disability
Provides an accelerated payout of your base plan in the unfortunate event of a
total and permanent disability.

You can utilise the base plan’s professional services benefit of S$5,000 and get
reimbursement for home care support, in the form of:
Home nursing services - when your caregiver needs a break or whenever
home nursing care is needed. 
Home modifications - when you need to install mobility aids like grab bars or
improve accessibility by widening doorways or installing ramps.
